exposure: implementation of a structured comprehensive multidisciplinary Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) management program
outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Newborns of mothers with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) who were followed in a tertiary medical center.
finding: Implementing a structured comprehensive multidisciplinary program to manage GDM women significantly improved the overall rate of neonatal complications, including a decreased incidence of macrosomia and a significant reduction of neonatal hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: The program was associated with an increased caesarian section rate.
